tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs gzungs chog dang bcas pa bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ ri khrod gnas su ri khrod ma'i// rnam par 'phrul pa kun 'phrul nas// 'gro ba'i rims sogs sel mdzad pa// ri khrod lo ma can la 'dud// ri khrod dpal mo mnyes byas pas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// dngos grub ma lus thob bya'i phyir// de yi bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// de la 'di'am gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa thob cing*/ 'di'i gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa'i lung thob pa/ 'di bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i don du/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bsgom par bya ba'i lha'i kha dog can gyi pam̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod lo ma can gyi dbu rgyan du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ na maḥpar+ṇa sha wa r+yi/ zhes pas lha mo la phyag 'tshal nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa r+yai/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo phul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes don bsams bzhin pas lan gsum brjod nas/

sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang me tog gi tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa pam̐ gyi yi ge gser gyi mdog can du bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas pam̐ la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can du gyur pa ni sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs brten zhing pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yas pas bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par bsgyings pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ g.yas pa'i zhal dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yon pa dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje dang*/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub la rdo rje zhags pas dkris pa/ gnyis pas me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab dang*/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che du ma dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ rab tu zhi zhing mdzes pa/

sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing*/ lang tsho la bab pa'i sku/ shin tu mdzes shing grims la/ cung zad khro ba'i tshul can du bsgom par bya'o// yang na phyag gnyis par bsam par bya ste/ sku mdog dmar mor zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs kyi tshogs la bsnun par mdzad cing*/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas gnod par byed pa thams cad kun du gzir ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyangs pa/ sku thung zhing sbom la brjid pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya'o// yang na phyag bzhi pa bsgom par bya ste/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma sku mdog ston ka'i nam mkha' ltar sngo zhing dwangs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ lha'i dpag bsam gyi shing las 'khrungs pa'i 'bras bus 'gro ba'i nad thams cad sel bar mdzad pa yin zhing*/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa bsnams pas gdug pa can rnams la bsnun par mdzad pa/ g.yon kyi dang pos rdo rje zhags pas bgegs kyi tshogs 'ching zhing*/ gnyis pas nor bu'i yu ba can gyi rnga yab dkar pos gdul bya rnams kyi nad sel bar mdzad pa/ shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ sgeg pa dang khro ba'i nyams can/ zhi ba dang drag po'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ shing lo gsar pa rnam par bkram pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i smad g.yogs mnabs pa/ g.yas cung zad bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can du bsgom par bya'o// 'di dag dus gcig la gsum ka bsgom par bya ba ni ma yin te/

gang la mos pa de bsgom par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po dang*/ mgrin par āḥdamar po dang*/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i pam̐ rang gi kha dog dang mthun par bsgom par bya'o// de nas pam̐ las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma gyon pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs pa la sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rang dang gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang pam̐ gyi yi ge de nyid las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag gsang sngags dang phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ dbang rtags su gyur pa ni/ phyag drug ma la mi bskyod pa/ gnyis pa la 'od dpag tu med pa/ bzhi pa la don yod grub par blta'o// de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la rang gi sems gtad nas mnyam par gzhag go /gang gi tshe sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe snying gi nang gi pam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad thams cad bsal bar bsams la/

oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla bar bya ste/ snying po'i sngags so// oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha pa rī hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni nye ba'i snying po'o// 'di'i rtsa ba'i sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ gzungs nyid nas 'byung ba bzhin bzla bar bya'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu/ yang snying 'bum phrag bco lngas ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga'o// de nas rang dang gzhan gyi don du bum pa'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la tshon rtsi dkar pos pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dar ram ras dkar po'i mgul chings prog lnga'am/ bdun dang ldan pas bcing*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gi rtse mo ma nyams pa'i chun pos kha brgyan no// rin po che lnga dang*/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ 'bru lnga dang bcas pa'i chu gtsang mas bkang pa bzhag pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i sder ma 'brus gang ba'i nang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang*/ 'di nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs shing*/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mchod rten bzhugs su gzhug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po dbub/ phyogs bzhir me tog dkar po'i phreng ba re gdags/ bre'am tog la gzungs thag kyang bcing ngo*// khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas kyis bskor/ sman dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ dmar gtor dang*/ yang dkar gtor gsum dang*/ dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ dkar gtor gcig gang 'os pa'i gtor ma gcig ste gtor ma dgu bsham mo// de nas rang nyid khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas gso sbyong blangs la/

gong du bstan pa ltar bdag bskyed bsgoms la bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o// de nas dri bzang gi chu ku shas bum pa dang mchod pa rnams la gtor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba dpag tu med pa bskyed nas so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// mchod rdzas rnams kyi dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa'i steng du bhūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod rten ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba bskyed la/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed do// de'i phyi rol gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ khor yug tu chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor ba blta'o// de dag gong du bstan pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang*// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// nad dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mchod yon/

de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū paṃ/ mar me dang*/ dī pam̐/ dri chab dang*/ ghan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ sil snyan dang*/ shab+da/ zhes pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yis// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gi sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun nas zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing dang yul rnams kun du rnam 'phrul zhing*// khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas// sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba// ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs cha lugs dang*// sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan gyis// rnam par sgeg pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas// me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud pa'i// shing lo gsar pa'i na bzas rab klubs pa// lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis// 'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas// gdug pa 'joms mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing*// brtse bas rjes chags dges pa chen po yis// tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma// rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la 'dud// sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas khyod kyi thugs// bskul bas bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas// bgegs dang nad sogs sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol// skye ba kun du bdag gi mgon mdzad de// nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab pa dang*// srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor zhing*// rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod// ces pas bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo// gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas bsgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas gzungs thag bzung la/

rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bcom ldan 'das ma'i rgyud bskul bas/ sku'i cha las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa'i nang gang ba dang*/ 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas/ bdag dang sems can gyi rims nad dang bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kyi gnod sems zhi bar bsam zhing*/ 'di'i snying po'i sngags gtso bor bzla'o// rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po'ang ci rigs par bzla bar bya'o// thun gyi mthar mchod cing bstod la gtor ma gtang bar bya ste/ de'ang gtor ma rnams sbyangs la/ thog mar a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang tshe dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bstabs pas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling gh+rih+nā pa ya gh+rīh+nā pa ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod nas bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa 'byung po dang*/ lnga pa klu rnams dang*/ drug pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis gtang ngo*// bdun pa gdon rigs kyi bdag po nag po'i phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba rnams la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis bsngos la drag po'i sngags kyis bskrad/ brgyad pa dkar po la dga' ba rnams la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta'i sngags kyis bsngos la/ chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces bsgo'o// dgu pa gzhi bdag dkar dang dmar la gang dga' ba de la a kā ro'i sngags kyis sbyin no// de nas mchod rten gyi nang na gnas pa'i lha 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba btab la bzod par gsol te/

gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol lo// de lta bu thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa'i rim pas/ zhag gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bsgrub pa byas pa'i mthar/ bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pas kha bskangs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo bar bya'o// bum pa'i steng du mchod rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos shing*/ gal te mchod rten med na bum pa'i nang ngam steng du lha bskyed par bya'o// mthar ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta'o// bsgrub bya nyung ngu'i don byed na dngos su bkru zhing*/ ku sha la sogs pa'i spyi bo nas gtor la/ khrus kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o// skye bo mang po dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ rta phyugs la sogs pa mang po'i don byed na/ shin tu gtsang zhing mtho ba'i sa phyogs su me long chen po la de dag gi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ gtor mas bsgrub bya de dag la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shā mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+rih+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags dang bcas pas gsum mam bdun la sogs pas de dag la gnod par byed pa rnams la byin la/ skye bo 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig ces brjod la/ drag po'i sngags dang rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byon nas/ bsgrub bya gang yin pa de'i nad rims dang 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sel ba la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par bsam zhing*/

'don pa'i grogs dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad brjod par bya'o// bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal to// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs pa/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsams pa/ dgra bcom pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ slob pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyis bsams pa/ bden pa'i tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyis bsams pa/ chos kyis bsams pa/ tshangs pas bsams pa/ tshangs pa so sos bsams pa/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gis bsams pa/ dbang pos bsams pa/ lhas bsams pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyi dbang pos bsams pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyis bsams pa/ lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pas bsams pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyis bsams pa/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal to// mun tsa ta/ mun tsa ta/ ma 'dug shig yams kyi nad rnam par zhi bar gyur cig nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ sangs rgyas lha chen po lha'i yang lha/ lha'i bla ma gshegs shing*/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dbang po dag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag kyang 'ong ngo*// lha 'bum phrag du ma dag dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang*/ lha ma yin 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong ngo*// bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po 'bum phrag dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyi 'ong ste/ de dag khyed rnams la gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ nirgats+tsha ta/ myur du byer cig khyed cag las gang dag ldang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing nye bar 'tshe bar mi 'dod la/ bsrung bar 'jug par 'dod pa de dag ni 'khod cig
